title: Formation of Independent Slovakia
description:
On January 1, 1993, **Slovakia** became an independent nation following the peaceful dissolution of Czechoslovakia, an event known as the "Velvet Divorce."

The split was the result of growing political and economic differences between the Czech and Slovak parts of the federation. Unlike the violent breakups of other federations in the region, the dissolution was negotiated peacefully by political leaders.

Vladimír Mečiar became the first Prime Minister of independent Slovakia, and Michal Kováč became the first President. Slovakia has since joined both NATO (2004) and the European Union (2004), and adopted the euro as its currency in 2009.
